newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Golf-O'Malley moves into one shot lead at Masters.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Golf-O'Malley moves into one shot lead at Masters.

text.p: Australian Peter O'Malley has picked up four shots in seven holes to take the lead at the Australian Masters at Huntingdale.
O'Malley has moved to 12 under par, one shot clear of Canada's Rick Gibson, who fired a second round 68.
American Tiger Woods, the tournament favourite, trails the leader by four shots on eight under after completing a second round 70.
Australian Robert Allenby is in the clubhouse in third place on ten under.
Overnight leader Lucas Parsons, who equalled the course record with a 64 on Thursday, is level par for the day after six holes.
